title: Brussels canal, ponds, Senne and small streams

records.name: Canal, Brussels

rule.text: Paddling is allowed in the port domain, but commercial shipping has priority.
conditions: Commercial traffic has priority: keep to the edge and give way to barges.

Read literally, the regulation requires a VHF radio and reporting to the Capitainerie (+32 2 247 91 21). Whether this is enforced for paddlers is not confirmed: a courtesy call before a transit is advised.
Portage around the Anderlecht and Molenbeek locks.
Swimming in the canal is forbidden.

link.title: Brussels police regulation for the canal and port (AGRBC of 4 March 2010, art. 127-128)

source.title: Brussels police regulation for the canal and port (AGRBC of 4 March 2010, art. 127-128)

records.unverified: Packrafts and SUPs aren't named in the regulation (read as small craft); notices to skippers can reserve zones; the port domain's edge is taken to be the whole canal in the region; the side basins are not drawn.

records.name: Ponds, Brussels

rule.text: Boats are not allowed on Brussels ponds without permission.

source.title: Bruxelles Environnement on boats on Brussels ponds (bx1, 7 May 2020)

records.unverified: The quote concerns the regional ponds; the City-managed ponds (such as the Bois de la Cambre) follow the City's own regulation, which wasn't found.

records.name: Senne (Zenne), Brussels

rule.text: The Senne runs mostly underground through Brussels; no rule for paddling it was found.

source.title: bx1: a kayak descent of the underground Senne (organised action)

records.unverified: No legal text was found. The only known descents were organised actions from a Vivaqua site.

records.name: Small streams, Brussels

rule.text: No rule for paddling Brussels' small streams was found; they are tiny and partly culverted.

source.title: Bruxelles Environnement: management and protection of non-navigable watercourses and ponds (ordinance of 16 May 2019)

records.unverified: Brussels law gives no default right to paddle non-navigable water; none was found either way.
